summary: Retest of Lokasi Kantor bug fix. Backend: added 7 new detailed location tests (seed check, valid create, invalid missing-name, invalid lat type, update, delete-then-verify, WFO inside-radius geofence success). Frontend: E2E flow (page load, empty lat validation, create, edit prefill+save, geolocation button non-crash, delete). Uncovered and fixed a real runtime bug in the rewritten LocationsPage: useEffect(load, []) passed a function that returned a Promise, causing React 'destroy is not a function' TypeError that broke the whole page. Fixed by wrapping in () => { load(); }. All 39 backend tests pass and full location UI flow works.

minor.issue: LocationCreate has no lat/lng/radius range constraints (accepts lat=1000 etc). Frontend validates, but backend should also enforce -90<=lat<=90, -180<=lng<=180, allowed_radius>0.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(load, []) passed function returning a Promise -> React TypeError 'destroy is not a function' shown as uncaught runtime error overlay when navigating away. Fixed by testing agent.

action_items: (Optional) Add server-side Pydantic validators to LocationCreate for lat/lng/radius bounds for defense in depth.
critical_code_review_comments: LocationsPage bug: passing a Promise-returning function directly as useEffect callback is a common React footgun. Always wrap: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []). Consider extracting load into useCallback if used elsewhere.
PUT /api/locations uses LocationCreate as body (all fields required). This is fine but treat semantics as full replacement; frontend correctly sends the full payload on edit.
Backend LocationCreate lacks field constraints (Field(..., ge=-90, le=90) etc.) — recommend adding for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ employees & locations; all cleaned up in-flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'lokasi kantor masih error' RCA: rewritten LocationsPage.jsx introduced useEffect(load, []) where load returned a Promise, triggering 'destroy is not a function'. Testing agent applied minimal fix (wrap in arrow function). All CRUD + validation + WFO geofence integration verified working. Location dialog test-ids all functional.
rca of the issue: Root cause of user's error: LocationsPage.jsx line 25 had `useEffect(load, [])` where `load` returns `api.get().then(...)` (a Promise). React expects the effect callback to return either undefined or a cleanup function; when it gets a Promise, on unmount React tries to call the Promise as a cleanup function -> 'destroy is not a function' TypeError, which surfaces as the uncaught runtime error overlay users saw. Reproduction: navigate to /admin/locations then to another route. Mitigation: changed to `useEffect(() => { load(); }, [])`. Verified via UI test that page now loads, CRUD works, no console errors.
